notes.title: GOO PHASE 2 | Q3 2018 Development Update
notes.notes:
We are updating the release window targets for Guardians of Orion Phase 2.  
[img]https://i.imgur.com/14IQyc7.png[/img]

[h1]GOO PHASE 2 - OUR BIGGEST & BEST SO FAR![/h1]
This is our largest production to date and has been underway for about a year now.  We knew going into this it wouldn't be easy just with the modules and content we wanted to deliver, but also the unexpected variables that can and do popup when lifting the hood.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T0OSptL.png[/img]

In my opinion GOO PHASE 2 is our greatest product to date and we cannot wait to share it with all of you - [i]but only when the time is right[/i].

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5z61zVF9fW2r0eX2sS/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]GOOD STUFF![/h1]
The good news is we've done most of the critical components already, including major aspects such as but not limited to:
[quote]
1. New game engine & technology integrations
2. New FPS Module
3. Optimizations & Polish (Technical)
4. Optimizations & Polish (Rendering)
5. Completely Remastered or Rebuilt Regions 
6. Harvest v2.0 
7. New Player HUD
8. SFX/VFX Remastering (Enemies, Worlds, Characters, Abilities, etc)
[/quote]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xFkj3FARjuGhFOs1xT/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]TIME VARIABLE UPDATE[/h1]
The remaining aspects are not nearly as complex as what has already been achieved, just more-so time consuming.  However we have missed our targeted window and have now entered a segment of the year in which is overly saturated and populated with other amazing games.   There are currently many things in motion and others that need to still be determined.    There is nothing specific to announce just yet as we evaluate new release window viability between ourselves and intended partners/platform(s).  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/stE9QeO.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/s0PxK6W.png[/img]

[h1]GAME PREVIEW POTENTIAL[/h1]
We are planning for ways that fans can play PHASE 2 before it officially comes out.  We are working on setting up a Playable Preview so those interested can experience things a bit sooner.  Beyond this and closer to the official public debut will likely be a 2nd play session in the form of a Beta. 
 More details as we get closer and finalize key aspects.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2uVIbWE.png[/img]

[h1]DOING WHAT IS BEST[/h1]
The sooner it's released, the better for EVERYONE so this choice is made with a heavy heart but one that is ultimately best for the game.

We want to get this out to all of you to enjoy and experience.  We have been working very hard on this product and are so proud of it.  This is by far the best work we've done to date and we cannot wait to show you what we have been working on so hard.  

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8cB2PWAx4xQQtWITZf/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]The best way to help is simply spread the word![/b]

Encourage people to check out the game or even all of the work completed on Phase 2 so far and helping bring additional awareness as we inch closer and closer.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LCXPgdC.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6mvgueY.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RIVJoITEBmcjOic0BY/giphy.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading and more to come soon.

notes.title: Kickstarter 1/2way Update + Future Plans
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eT7ouSD.png[/img]

Hello Guardians!

It is no surprise that we constantly want to grow and evolve our games.  Guardians of Orion is no different!  We have so many ideas for content and modules and so do our fans.  We want to make as many of them as possible and the developers on Guardians of Orion have been willing to commit years of their life to fulfilling this experience!
https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries

https://youtu.be/mvDqJT3DL8o

( 2016 CROWDFUNDING )
We are halfway through the duration of our Kickstarter campaign and it's the time where we evaluate the current standing of models we are using.  We've been here before (2014, 2015) and we suspect and must operate under the understanding that this 2016 crowdfunding event will follow the same trajectory.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion/posts/1395367

*Note: If the Kickstarter is unsuccessful your donations won't be collected.  We encourage any and all supporters to focus onto our Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries
*Note: If the Kickstarter is successful we will use it to continue to grow and evolve the game by adding even more content and modules.  The more you support us the more we can support you.

( 2017 CROWDFUNDING MODEL ) 
https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries
We're going to let the 2016 Kickstarter run it's course.  We still have just about a month and we still have many campaigns, announcements and interactions as we lead up to the massive Guardians of Orion Official Release via Steam on December 20, 2016.  We hope it will succeed but beyond that we ultimately want to:
1. Have an effective model in place that raises more resources which would allow us to deliver more content and modules.
2. Allow fans to have control over the fate of the game and how large it can become.
3. Reward fans with awesome rewards and gifts.

( PATREON )
Our first goal with Patreon (monthly crowdfunding) is to offset the current costs of servers via community support and rewards.  The largest expense every month is the server infrastructure/operational costs.  
https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries

( EXCLUSIVE REWARDS FOR PATRONS )
We like to offer incredible rewards whenever it comes to fan involvement and our Patreon will offer the most exclusive and incredible rewards to date.  We have options for rewards such as:
· Access to DevBetas
· Access to DevDiscords
· Access to Patron-only updates & information
· 1on1 Monthly Dev Chats (Skype/Facetime)
· Private Group Monthly Dev Meetings
· Priority Access to many modules, events and savings
· A variety of music albums!
· Invites to local meetups
· Invites to VIP events (conferences, expos, release parties)
· Physical Items (Shirts, Hoodies, Coffee Cups)
· Limited Edition Items (Statues, Plushies)
· Savings on all Trek/Orion Games
· Coupons for the Trek Store
& more!


( SUSTAINABILITY )
The *good* thing about these servers is that the current price will not grow much even if the player count increases as this is simply the minimum viable operational costs for them to exist.  The only times they would grow is when we add ADDITIONAL servers such as new locations around the world to help users better connect. 

( MORE APPROACHABLE )
This also keeps the crowdfunding total(s) significantly lower allowing for much more achievable community-based goals, a win for both developers and fans alike.

( LESS=MORE )
The less we have to invest in the operational costs of these servers the more we can invest into adding new content and modules that further your game experience. 

( OUR MEDICINE )
We've been working extremely hard on Guardians of Orion v2.0.  We are on track for the public release which is rapidly approaching on Dec 20, 2016 and we expect that the new pricing model and content model will better support the game going forward to where we can focus on more exciting goals and continue to evolve the game in exciting and new ways courtesy of your interaction and support.

( OFFICIAL RELEASE ) 
Guardians of Orion is officially releasing via Steam on December 20, 2016.  Buy it now while in Early Access to save big $$$

notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2xZ5XEl.png[/img]

[h1]ORION - COMMUNITY UPDATE (OCT 2016)[/h1]
We have recently conducted a variety of pools and information gathering to learn where the Community is in regards to what they are enjoying, disliking and think of ORION.  We do these polls regularly and we appreciate all who interact with and supply feedback.  Thank you very much to all of you!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/c5ccWEZ.png[/img]

[b]You can view each of these below:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1.[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/343787920121709087/] Best Things About The Game?[/url]
[*] 2. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/343787920121707338/] Worst Things About The Game?[/url]
[*] 3. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791433474819/announcements/detail/845941345800176106] Thoughts About ORION PT. 1[/url]
[*] 4. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791433474819/announcements/detail/845941345800176106] Thoughts About ORION PT. 2[/url]
[/list]

[h1]BEST THINGS ABOUT ORION (MOST VOTED):[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1. Gameplay 
[*] 2. Play Styles (Gear/Skills/Abilities)
[*] 3. Player Customization
[*] 4. The Community
[*] 5. Guardian Variety
[/list]

[h1]WORST THINGS ABOUT ORION (MOST VOTED):[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1. Weapon Impact/Feel/Recoil/Movement
[*] 2. Verticality
[*] 3. Optimization (ATI/AMD)
[*] 4. Weapon Loadouts
[*] 5. Game Launch Time
[*] 7. Input Customization
[/list]

[h1]OTHER VOTES INCLUDED (SINGLE VOTES):[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1. Steam Achievements
[*] 2. Ion Conversion Ratio
[*] 3. Chat System
[*] 4. Pet Following/Proximity/Blocking
[*] 5. Third Person Camera Tweaks
[*] 6. Legendary Aug Functionality (?)
[*] 7. Gibs/Gore Improvements
[*] 8. Survival Mode Remake
[*] 9. PhysX quality options (GPU support)
[*] 10. Latency/Server improvements
[*] 11. Remade Support Ability
[/list]

[b]We've also received many fan submissions stating that they believe:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1. The game is TOO ambitious.
[*] 2. We don't address issues fast enough.
[*] 3. We add content TOO often.
[/list]

[h1]SO WHAT DO WE DO WITH THIS INFORMATION?[/h1]
Well, we use it!  We read through every post and curate lists based on the most-submitted.  If something can coexist with other systems, designs and mechanics either integrated or planned then it is included.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dP9NeBw.png[/img]

[h1]VERSION 1.7 - NOVEMBER 2016[/h1]
Most of the main dislikes *will* be addressed in the next major update for ORION, Version 1.7  

ORION v1.7 is scheduled for release in November 2016 and we will be addressing the following:
[list]
[*] 1. Adding additional weapon loadouts per Guardian.
[*] 2. Adding ADS (Aim-Down-Sights) functionality for the FPS perspective.
[*] 3. We are revamping the Weapon Movement & Recoil systems.
[*] 4. We've improved verticality to older maps and made it a focus on the newer maps.
[*] 5. We've added small additions to A.I to better compensate for the new verticality.
[*] 6. We've added game optimizations (auto-spec detection, based on your specific hardware).
[*] 7. We've added input customization for mechanics including: Blink, Evade, Jump, Crouch.
[/list]

[h1]VERSION 1.8 & OTHER[/h1]
In addition to polishing and improving those features, we are also going to continue to focus on what the game currently has.  Version 1.8 will debut some new content but also focus on further polishing the PvE and PvP modules already within the game.  This includes Harvest, Mayhem, Survival and WarGames.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1Bd2qjL.png[/img]

[h1]POST BELOW![/h1]
We always monitor fan feedback.  Feel free to post comments, suggestions and questions below.  We always love hearing what you think!

notes.title: Trek August 2016 Update (F2P Canned)
notes.notes:
[h1]( THE ORION PROJECT )[/h1]
The ORION Project is a Sci-Fi Shooter featuring Dinosaurs and Robots and it's focused on Accessibility, Over-The-Top Gameplay, Power Ups, Local & Online Co-Op, Social Hubs, Destruction and more! ORION is the successor to the multi-platinum indie hit: ORION: Prelude.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

https://youtu.be/W9bvRGv9J3U

[h1]( PRELUDE IS FREE! )[/h1]
Play our first game, ORION: Prelude for FREE!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900

https://youtu.be/2Uu0C359l9Y

[h1]( VERSION 1.6.0 PREVIEW BUILD )[/h1]
We recently released a preview version of 1.6.0 to gain additional feedback and information pertaining to what is the largest content update to the game yet!  Thanks to all who participated and submitted feedback as this helped us squash many issues before the big debut.

https://youtu.be/xsUEmzpVzg0

We had a few issues arise once going public and the biggest two issues related to the Automatic Shotgun (server crashing bug) and another issue related to Inventory/Slots.  

[h1]( INVENTORY REPAIR )[/h1]
To repair the crafting/resource issue we are expecting to do an ION bonus to all users who played during that period.  This will be applied in the full release of v1.6.0 coming in the first week of September 2016.

[h1]( v1.6.0p BETA TESTING )[/h1]
If you wish to continue helping us test and find any other anomalies please contact us via:
iwanttohelp@trek-industries.com

[h1]( PREMIUM PRELUDE HELMETS )[/h1]
This is integrated and ready.  We are only waiting on one change from Steams end and when applied these will redeem in your 1.6.0 game build.

[h1]( SOME RECENT CHANGES )[/h1]
Initially were were going to delay the F2P edition to coincide with Version 1.7 in September 2016 once the 1.6.0p issues started to appear.  This would allow us to further polish and even add new content (Guardian, Dino, Weapon, etc) to celebrate.  

However we were recently contacted by one of our development partners stating that our back end services were going to cost more going forward.  They are doing this towards all of their clients as they referenced they need to make their business more efficient.  

In addition to the price hike it appears that many aspects of how things will work will be changing or modified and have a new cost associated.  This was unexpected on our end and affects some of our immediate plans greatly.  Notably the F2P edition.   I am OK with a little risk, but not risk in every direction and there are too many variables that are now unknown.  

[h1]( F2P EDITION CANCELLED )[/h1]
As of this update the F2P edition of The Orion Project is cancelled until further notice as we will need to re-evaluate not only our partner, but the backend itself as well as look into other options to ensure these types of surprises and changes don't happen in the future.  

[h1]( PIONEER STATUS / ELITE STATUS + ION )[/h1]
If you had an issue with not receiving ION from from a Pioneer Status transaction this will be resolved in the 1.6.0 update in Sept 2016.  If you have an issue with Elite ION this will be resolved in August 2016.

[h1]( XBOX ONE GIVEAWAY )[/h1]
Your chance at a FREE Xbox One!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F6BoF1bF_aw

[h1]( FOLLOW OUR DEVELOPMENT ON TWITCH.TV )[/h1]
https://www.twitch.tv/dprassel

Any questions?
connect@trek-industries.com

notes.title: Version 1.6 - Changing Things Up (Guardians)
notes.notes:
Version 1.6 - Changing Things Up
We recently re-designed how Guardian Purchases will work going forward, likely starting with Version 1.6. I want to split up the cost of the Guardians as they currently stand, and to do this the best way is to split the gameplay from the visual:

1. We are going to sell new Guardians (aka Playstyles) for $5. This includes the Ability, Weapon Loadout, Voice and more. 

2. Then we are going to sell the Armor pieces separately for the other $5, which would include the Helmet, Arms, Legs and Chest.

So it's still all the same content and this will allow us to add tons of armor to the store for users to enjoy at a much faster rate without having to hold it back to wait for Guardian/programming integration. It also allows more affordable prices across each and allows users to get exactly what they want.

notes.title: Version 1.6 - First Details!
notes.notes:
We are gearing up to release Version 1.5 in the next couple of days/week and are very excited to share what we've been working on with you.

We have had the Pre-Production and Production teams working on Version 1.6 and 1.7 while the Integration team finished off 1.5.  We have just settled on the main focus areas for 1.6 and they are listed below:

[h1] MECHS! [/h1]
We are going to launch with three classes and a unit per each.  This is in addition to a unique set of weaponry created just for the mechs.

[h1] PvP! [/h1]
We are going to launch Version 1.6 with three PvP game modes!

[b]( MAYHEM ) (40 Players) (Free-For-All)[/b]
[list]
[*] This is one of the largest PvP mode offerings for the immediate future.  
[*] This will use specialized NEW maps like The Cove + The Island.
[*] This allows for ALL Guardians to be used and will be a great way to see ability VS ability.
[/list]

[b]( HARVESTER HUNT ) (4v4, Team Elimination)[/b]
[list]
[*] This pits two teams against one another, each tasked with having to protect their Harvester unit from the enemy team AND wild life, all while trying to eliminate the opposing teams unit.
[*] This will use existing maps such as Relic, Haven, Strike and more.
[/list]

[b]( MECH WARS ) (4v4, Team Objective)[/b]
[list]
[*] This will feature all the new mechs and mech content and pay homage to other games like Mech Assault and Titan Fall.
[*] This will use existing maps such as Relic, Haven, Strike and more.
[/list]

notes.title: We Like RPG's - Do You?! (Version 1.7 Preview)
notes.notes:
[h1]VERSION 1.7 WILL BE EPIC![/h1]
We have just started Pre-Production on Version 1.6 and Version 1.7. We are especially excited for 1.7 because it will be the first time we are able to introduce new creatures and species from within the Orion universe.

We are adding many Social/RPG modules inside of 1.7, including the Exploration Module. This is scheduled to allow you to explore three massive locations at launch, including Nova City, The Cove and Enclave. There are unique characters in each location and you'll be able to interact with them to Buy, Shop and Trade!

[quote]
[h1]MORTY FLINT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 8 Feet, 6 Inches
[*] Weight: 1,250 Pounds
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dsBiJsv.jpg[/img]
Here is the first sketch of Morty Flint, a Rekan species from the Rock World of Okra. Many of the Rekan species were bred as warriors due to their nearly indestructible skin.

Now retired from war, Morty can be found in the Mining Colony of Nova City where he sells Weapons & Gear for a price.
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]RUNO OSO[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 4 Feet, 2 Inches
[*] Weight: 125 Pounds
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wyKDW1E.jpg[/img]
Here is the first sketch of Runo Oso, a Geema species from the Wetlands World of Sangshin. Due to their proximity to the mining world of Nova City they had immense access to broken or lost technology and salvage courtesy of the cargo runs near orbit.

This allowed constant exposure to technology and devices allowing the Geemans to interact with it for extended generations making them some of the best engineers in the New Solar System.

Runo Oso now occupies Nova City and can be found selling Personal Drones in the back alleys.
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]DOVION "THE DEALER"[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 6 Feet, 2 Inches
[*] Weight: 185Pounds
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/knCIX7q.jpg[/img]
Dovion "The Dealer" came over on the first voyage and was largely known as a Smuggler or Pirate.  

Once Dovion arrived to Orion he instantly became obsessed with the Ion Crystals ("Blue Gold") and would collect them to shave them down into dust and then inhale it. Dovion would later help traffic what was known as Ion Dust which many people became addicted.  

Originally a Human, he's become something much more through his extended and direct use of Ionic energy.  Don't mess with him.  You can find Dovion in the back alleys of Nova City.
[/quote]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840

notes.title: Version 1.3 - Optimization Incoming!
notes.notes:
Great news Guardians!  Yesterday we discovered the culprit that was causing some of you to lose FPS while in Third Person mode.  

We were already nearing the release of Version 1.3 so we have been working endlessly to ensure that it doesn't delay 1.3 and we are still on track.  The issue affected every single map so they all needed to be re-worked.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/h4ACENk.png[/img]

We wanted to cover it a bit more in detail below for those interested.  The issue was the foliage.  It wasn't necessarily the amount of foliage, it was just how it was placed.  The overdraw was from empty space in alpha-masked textures.  This would occur in Third-Person because the empty space was stacking on top of one another and due to their size this was happening many times over before it was faded or occluded.  You wouldn't typically have any stack occurring in Top-Down which is why those frames were typically unaffected.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Quxt8fO.png[/img]

What are Alpha Mask Textures?  These are parts of a texture/material that tell an area to be invisible when in use.  This is used on things like grass because games use square-shaped textures and grass is very much not a square so you color in blades of the grass and alpha-map the non-blade parts to be invisible. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Evdu86d.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/yi2BmUJ.png[/img]

This will be fixed for Version 1.3 and we will be very curious to see how those who were affected can handle Third Person now.
